architecture_findings.stack: SvelteKit 2 SSR + Cloudflare Turnstile + Rackspace CDN (`olbg-shared.scdn1.secure.raxcdn.com`)
architecture_findings.tipster_consensus_formula: confidence = round(100 * win_tips / win_tips_count); stars_rating in {0..5} combines tipster profitability weighting (LSP) with consensus ratio vs implied odds (1 / decimal_odds).
architecture_findings.subhub_hydration_trap: Competition sub-routes such as /betting-tips/Basketball/NBA/USA/4 and /betting-tips/Ice_Hockey/NHL/USA/13 serve 183 KB empty shells ('No tips found.') to non-JS clients because competition filters hydrate via client-side XHR to tipsb.olbg.info, whereas top-level sport hubs (/betting-tips/<Sport>/<ID>) embed full SvelteKit SSR tip arrays.
architecture_findings.ssr_cache_invalidation_defect: At 2026-10-23T19:42:48Z, OLBG top-level hubs still served 81 already-commenced or completed events with expired='0' (including completed WST Northern Ireland Open QFs and Oct 22 NHL games), proving every fixture must be time-filtered and verified against official governing-body live status.
architecture_findings.in_running_golf_behavior: Golf (/betting-tips/Golf/5) embeds 0 pre-event SSR rows once Thursday Round 1 tees off because OLBG closes outright tournament tip markets at Round 1 start; live tournaments must be sourced directly from PGA Tour, DP World Tour, and LPGA official leaderboards.
